qc.label_under_test: In multi-line code, a variable name that is already defined (a function argument or an earlier assignment) when it is reused, strongest when it begins a line (before +=, [..], .method()); first-time definitions, literals, undefined names and prose stay near floor.

neighbours.label: In multi-line code, a name that opens a statement line as an already-defined object about to be worked on (before .method(), [..] or +=); the same name mid-line is weaker, and calls, keywords, new assignments, undefined names, one-line snippets and prose stay near floor.
